G1900.def:
ἐπ-έκεινα
adv. (= ἐπ᾽ ἐκεῖνα), [in LXX: Lv 22:27, Nm 32:19, al. (הָלְאָה), etc. ;]
beyond; with genitive, At 7:43 (LXX) †
(AS)

G1901.def:
ἐπ-εκ-τείνω
to extend: mid., to stretch forward: with dative, Fp 3:13.†
(AS)

G1902.def:
ἐπ-εν-δύω
= -δύνω (Hdt.),
to put on over; pass. (Plut., al.), to have on over, be clothed upon: 2Co 5:2-4.†
(AS)

G1903.def:
ἐπενδύτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐπενδύω), [in LXX for מְעִיל Lv 8:7 A (Aq. ἐπένδυμα), 3Ki.18:4 A, 4Ki.13:18 * ;]
an outer tunic (RV, coat): Jo 21:7 .†
(AS)

G1904.def:
ἐπ-έρχομαι,
[in LXX for בּוֹא, עָבַר, etc. ;]
__1. to come to, arrive, come on: before ἀπό, with genitive loc., At 14:19 (ἐπῆλθαν; cf. M, Pr., 65; Deiss., BS, 191); of time, Ef 2:7.
__2. to come upon (as in Hom.): of calamities, Lc 21:26, At 8:24 13:40, Tg 5:1; of an enemy, Lc 11:22; of the Holy Spirit, Lc 1:35, At 1:8, [in LXX: γίγνομαι ἐπί, Jz 14:6, 3Ki.11:6, al.].†
(AS)

G1905.def:
ἐπ-ερωτάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל, also for דָּרַשׁ, etc. ;]
__1. to in­quire of, consult, question: with accusative of person(s), Mc 12:34, Lc 2:46, al.; with dupl. accusative, Mc 7:17 11:29, Lc 20:40, al.; with accusative of person(s), before λέγων, Mt 12:18, Mc 9:11; εἰ, Mc 8:23, Lc 23:6, al.; ἐ. θεόν, Rm 10:20 (LXX).
__2. In late Gk., to beg of, demand of: with accusative of person(s) and inf., Mt 16:1 (cf. ἐρωτάω; and see Cromer, 716)
(AS)

G1906.def:
ἐπ-ερώτημα, -τος, τό
[in LXX: Da TH Dn 4:14 (שְׁאֵלָא), Sir.33:3 * ;]
__1. a question, au inquiry (Hdt., Thuc.).
__2. a demand: 1Pe 3:21 (see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G1907.def:
ἐπ-έχω
[in LXX for חָדַל, etc.; also Sir.8:1 34:2, 2Ma.5:25 2Mac 9:25, al. ;]
__1. to hold upon.
__2. Like παρέχω (as in Hom., al.), to hold out, offer: λόγον ζωῆς, Fp 2:16.
__3. to hold or direct towards, Sc.νοῦν;
__(a) absol., to intend, purpose;
__(b) to observe, give attention to (see MM, Exp., xiv): before πῶς, Lc 14:7; with dative of person(s), At 3:5, 1Tm 4:16.
__4. to stay, wait: At 19:22 (in legal phrase, MM, Exp., l.with).†
(AS)

G1908.def:
ἐπηρεάζω
(ἐπήρεια, spiteful abuse),
to revile: with accusative of person(s), Lc 6:28; with accusative of thing(s) (but see ICC, in l), 1Pe 3:16.†
(AS)

G1909.def:
ἐπί (before a smooth breathing ἐπ᾽, before a rough breathing ἐφ᾽),
prep. with genitive, dative, accusative (accusative most frequently in NT),
with primary sense of superposition, on, upon.
__I. C. genitive,
__1. of place, answering the question, where?
__(a) of the place on which, on, upon: ἐπὶ (τ.) γῆς, Mt 6:10, 19, al.; τ. κεφαλῆς, 1Co 11:10; τ. νεφελῶν, Mt 24:3o, al.; like ἐν, in constr. praegn. after verbs of motion: βάλλειν, Mc 4:26; σπείρειν, ib. 31; ἔρχεσθαι, Hb 6:7, al.; figuratively, ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας (MM, see word ἀ.); of the subject of thought or speech, Gl 3:16; of power or authority, over, πάντων, Rm 9:5: τ. γάζης, At 8:27; ἐξουσία, Ap 2:26 20:6;
__(b) of vicinity, at, by: τ. θαλάσσης, Jo 6:9; τ. ὁδοῦ, Mt 21:19; τοῦ βάτου, Mc 12:26 (see Swete, in l.); with genitive of person(s), in the presence of, before, Mt 28:14, At 23:30, 1Co 6:1, al.
__2. Of time,
__(a) with genitive of person(s), in the time of: ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου, Lc 4:27; ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου, At 11:28; ἐπὶ Ἀβιάθαρ ἀρχιερέως, when A. was high priest, Mc 2:26;
__(b) with genitive of thing(s), at, at the time of: Mt 1:11, Hb 1:2, 2Pe 3:3; ἐπὶ τ. προσευχῶν, Rm 1:10, Ef 1:16, 1Ts 1:2, Phm 4.
__II. C. dative, of place, answering the question, where?
__(a) lit., on, upon: Mt 9:16, 14:8, al.; after verbs of motion (see supr., I, 1, (a)), Mt 9:16 At 8:16; above, Lc 23:38; at, by, Mc 13:29, Jo 5:2, At 5:9, al.;
__(b) metaphorically, upon, on the ground of, Lc 4:4 (LXX); in the matter of, Mc 6:52 (see Swete, in l.); upon, of, concerning, At 5:35, 40; of the ground, reason or motive (Bl., §38, 2; 43, 3), Mt 18:3 19:9, Rm 12:12, al.; ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, for the reason that, because, Rm 5:12 2Co 5:4; after verbs of motion, over, Mt 18:13, Rm 16:19, al.; of a condition (cl.), Rm 8:20, 1Co 9:10; ἐπὶ δυσὶ μάρτυσιν (see Westc. on Hb 9:10), Hb 10:28; of purpose or aim, Ef 2:10, Fp 4:10; of authority, over, Mt 24:47 Lc 12:44; of hostility, with dative of person(s) (cl.), against, Lc 12:52; in addition to (cl.), 2Co 7:13; of an adjunct, in, at, on, Fp 1:3 2:17.
__III. C. accusative,
__1. of place of motion upon or over, answering the question, whither?
__(a) lit., upon, over: Mt 14:28, 29, Lc 5:19, al. mult.; in NT also, answering the question, where? (as with genitive, dative), Mc 4:38 11:2, Lc 2:25, Jo 1:32; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, At 1:15 2:1, al.; of motion to a vicinity, to, Mc 16:2, At 8:36, al.;
__(b) metaphorically (in wh. "the accusative is more widely prevalent than it strictly should be," Bl., §43, 1); of blessings, evils, etc., coming upon one, with accusative of person(s), Mt 10:13 12:28, At 2:17, Jo 18:4, Ef 5:6, al.; of addition (dative in cl.), λύπη ἐπὶ λύπην, Fp 2:27; ἐπικαλεῖν ὄνομα ἐπί (see: ἐπικαλέω), At 15:17, Tg 2:7; καλεῖν ἐπί, to call after, Lc 1:59; of number or degree: ἐπὶ τρίς (cl. εἰς τ.), thrice, At 10:16 11:10; ἐπὶ πλεῖον, the more, further, At 4:17 2Tm 2:16 3:9 (see also infr., 2, (a)); ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (see infr., ib.), forasmuch as, Mt 25:40, 45, Rm 11:13; of power, authority, control, Lc 1:33, At 7:10 Rm 5:14, Hb 3:6, al.; of the direction of thoughts and feelings, unto, towards, Lc 1:17 23:28, At 9:35, 42, Rm 11:22, Gl 4:9, Ef 2:7, 1Tm 5:5, al.; of purpose, for, Mt 3:7, Lc 23:48; ἐφ᾽ ὅ πάρει (Rec. ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, Mt 26:50; of hostility, against, Mt 24:7, Mc 3:24-26 10:11 13:8, Lc 9:5, Jo 13:18, At 7:54, 1Co 7:36, 2Co 1:23; Of reference, concerning, for (cl. usually dative), Mc 9:12 15:24, Jo 19:24, Rm 4:9.
__2. Of time,
__(a) during, for: Lc 4:25 (WH, txt., omits ἐπί), At 13:31 16:18, Hb 11:30, al.; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (χρόνον), as long as, for so long time as, Mc 9:15 Rm 7:1, al. (for ἐφ᾽ ὅ in another sense, see supr., 1, (b)); ἐφ᾽ ἱκανόν (see: ἱ), At 20:11; ἐπὶ πλεῖον (see supr., 1, (b)), yet longer, further, At 20:9 24:4;
__(b) on, about, towards (cl. εἰς): Lc 10:35 At 3:1 4:5.
__IV. In composition, ἐπί signifies: up, ἐπαίρω; upon, ἐπίγειος, ἐπιδημέω, ὠπικαθίζω; towards, επιβλέπω, ὠπεκτείνω; over (of superintendence), ἐπιστάτης; again, in addition, ἐπαιτέω; against, ἐπιορκέω, ἐπιβουλή.
(AS)

G1910.def:
ἐπι-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב ;]
__1. to get up on, mount: before ἐπί, with accusative, Mt 21:5 (LXX); to embark in (a boat), go aboard: with dative, At 27:2; before εἰς, At 21:6 (Rec.); absol., At 21:2.
__2. to go up to, go on to, enter: before εἰς, At 20:18 21:4; with dative, At 25:1.†
(AS)

G1911.def:
ἐπι-βάλλω
[in LXX for שָׁלַח, שִׁית, etc. ;]
__1. trans., to cast, lay or put upon: with accusative and dative, Mc 11:7, 1Co 7:35; with accusative, before ἐπί with accusative, Ap 18:10, WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, Mt 26:50, Lc 20:19 21:12, Jo 7:30, At 5:18 21:27; with dative (Polyb.), Mc 14:46 At 4:3; with inf., At 12:1; τὴν χ. ἐπ᾽ ἄροτρον, Lc 9:62; ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ ἱμάτιον, Lc 5:36; ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ, Mt 9:16.
__2. Intrans.,
__(a) to throw oneself or rush upon: τ. κύματα εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Mc 4:37; metaphorically, to put one's mind upon (but see Field, Notes, 41 ff.), ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν, when he thought thereon (sc. τ. ῥήματι), he wept (EV, txt.; R, mg., he began to weep; cf. M, Pr., 131): Mc 14:72 (see also Swete, in l);
__(b) to fall to one's share: τὸ ἐπιβάλλον (sc. dative; Hdt., a1., a technical formula frequently in π.; Deiss., BS, 230, LAE, 152), Lc 15:12.†
(AS)

G1912.def:
ἐπι-βαρέω, -ῶ
to put a burden on, be burdensome: figuratively, absol., 2Co 2:6; with accusative of person(s), 1Ts 2:9, 2Ts 3:8 (cf. M, Th., I, 29).†
(AS)

G1913.def:
ἐπι-βιβάζω
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב hi. ;]
to place upon: with accusative of person(s), Lc 10:34 19:35, At 23:24.†
(AS)

G1914.def:
ἐπι-βλέπω
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., פָּנָה, רָאָה, etc. ;]
to look upon. In NT, as in LXX (1Rs 1:11 9:1, Sl 25:16; Tob.3:3, al.), to look on with favour: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Lc 1:48 9:38, Tg 2:3.†
(AS)

G1915.def:
ἐπί-βλημα, -τος, τό
[in LXX: Is 3:22 * ;]
__1. that which is thrown over, a cover.
__2. a tapestry, hanging (Is, l.with).
__3. that which is put on;
__(a) embroidery;
__(b) a patch: Mt 9:16, Mc 2:21, Lc 5:36.†
(AS)

G1917.def:
ἐπι-βουλή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Et 2:22, I Et 5:73, 2Ma.5:7, al. ;]
a plan against, a plot: At 9:24 20:3, 19 23:30.†
(AS)

G1918.def:
ἐπι-γαμβρεύω
(γαμβρός, a connection by marriage) [in LXX: Gn 34:9, 1Rs 18:21 ff., 2Cr 18:1, Et 9:14 (חָתַן hithp.), Gn 38:8 R (יָבַם pi.), 1Ma.10:54-56 * ;]
__1. to enter into affinity with: with dative (LXX, H. with, exc. Gn 38:8).
__2. to marry (as deceased husband's next of kin, cf. Gn 38:8): with accusative, Mt 22:24.†
(AS)

G1919.def:
ἐπί-γειος, -ον
(ἐπί, γῆ),
of the earth, earthly: τὰ ἐ., Jo 3:12 Fp 2:10 3:19 (anarth.); σώματα, 1Co 15:40; οἰκία, 2Co 5:1; σοφία, Tg 3:15 (Cremer, 153).†
(AS)

G1920.def:
ἐπι-γίνομαι (see: γίνομαι)
[in LXX: Ep. Jr 47:1-7, 3Ma.2:6 * ;]
to arrive, arise, come on: At 28:13.†
(AS)

G1921.def:
ἐπι-γινώσκω
[in LXX chiefly for נָכַר: hi., also for יָדַע, etc. ;]
"directive" of γινώσκω (AR, Eph., 249), as in cl.;
__1. to observe, perceive, discern, recognize;
__(a) absol.: At 25:10, 1Co 13:12; before ὅτι, Lc 1:22; τ. πνεύματι, before ὅτι, Mc 2:8;
__(b) with accusative of thing(s): Lc 1:4 5:22, At 12:14 27:39, Rm 1:32, 2Co 1:13, Cl 1:6, 1Tm 4:3; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, Mc 5:30; before ὅτι, 1Co 14:37;
__(with) with accusative of person(s): Mt 11:27 14:36 17:12, Mc 6:33 (T, αὐτούς, but LTr., WH, R, omit the prop., and LTr., WH, txt., read ἔγνωσαν), Mc 6:54 Lc 24:16, 31, 1Co 16:18, 2Co 1:14; before ἀπό, with genitive of thing(s), Mt 7:16, 20; before ὅτι, At 3:10 4:13, 2Co 13:5; pass., 1Co 13:12; opposite to ἀγνοούμενοι, 2Co 6:9.
__2. to discover, ascertain, determine: At 9:30; before ὅτι, Lc 7:37 23:7, At 19:34 22:29 24:11 28:1; with accusative of thing(s), before quæst., At 23:28; δι᾽ ἣν αἰτίαν, At 22:24; παρά, with genitive of person(s), before περ, with genitive of thing(s), At 24:8; τ. ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης, 2Pe 2:21 (cf. Lft., Col., 136; Cremer, 159; M, Pr., 113; AR, Eph., 248 ff.).†
(AS)

G1922.def:
ἐπί-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιγινώσκω, which see), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:14 (B. γν-), Pv 2:5, Os 4:1, 6 6:6 (דַּעַת), Jdth.9:14, 2Ma.9:11 * ;]
acquaintance, discernment, recognition (Plut., al.): Fp 1:9, Cl 3:10; with genitive of thing(s), Cl 1:9 2:2, Phm 6; τ. ἀληθείας, 1Tm 2:4, 2Tm 2:25 3:7, Tt 1:1, Hb 10:26; τ. ἁμαρτίας, Rm 3:20; with genitive of person(s), of God: Ef 1:17, Cl 1:10, 2Pe 1:2-3; of Christ: Ef 4:13, 2Pe 1:8 2:20; of God and Christ: 2Pe 1:2; κατ ̓ ἐ., Rm 10:2; ἔχειν ἐν ἐ., Rm 1:28 (see AR, Eph., 248 ff.; and for a somewhat different view, Thayer, see word; Lft. on Col, 1:9; Tr., Syn., LXXv; Cremer, 159 f.; cf. αἴσθησις).†
(AS)

G1924.def:
ἐπι-γράφω
[in LXX for כָּתַב, Nm 17:2; fig., Jr 31:33, al. ;]
to write upon, inscribe: Mc 15:26, At 17:23, Ap 21:12; figuratively, Hb 8:10 (LXX) Hb 10:16.†
(AS)

G1925.def:
ἐπι-δείκνυμι
[in LXX: Pv 12:17 (פּוּחַ hi.), Is 37:26 (בּוֹא hi.), Esp. Jer.59, 2Ma.15:32, al ;]
__1. to show, exhibit, display: with accusative and dative, Mt 16:1 22:19 24:1, Lc 17:14. Mid., to display for oneself or as one's own (but cf. El., § 55, 1): At 9:39.
__2. to show, point out, prove: with accusative, Hb 6:17; with accusative and inf., At 18:28 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G1926.def:
ἐπι-δέχομαι
[in LXX: Jdth.13:13 B2, 1Ma.10:1 1Mac 14:23, Sir.51:26, al. ;]
__1. in cl., of things, to allow of, admit of (Dem., Arist., al.). In late writers,
__2. to accept besides (Polyb.), to accept (in π. of the terms of a lease; see ICC, on 3Jo, l.with): III Jn 9.
__3. (a) to receive besides (Menand.);
__(b) to receive hospitably (1Mac, Sir, ll with): III Jn 10†
(AS)

G1927.def:
ἐπι-δημέω, -ῶ
(δῆμος);
__1. to be at home (Thuc., Plat., al.),
__2. to stay in a place, sojourn (Plat., Xen., al.; and see MM, Exp., xiv): At 2:10 17:21; before ἐν, At 18:27 (WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G1928.def:
ἐπι-δια-τάσσομαι
to add provisions to a document: Gl 3:15 (cf. ἐπιδιαθήκη, a second will, F1J, BJ, ii, 2, 3; the word is used of wills in π., cf. Deiss., LAE, 87).†
(AS)

G1929.def:
ἐπι-δίδωμι
[in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;]
__1. to give over, to hand: with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mt 7:9, 19, Lc 11:11-12 24:30, 42, At 15:30; pass. with dative of person(s), Lc 4:17.
__2. to give in, give way: absol., At 27:15.†
(AS)

G1930.def:
ἐπι-δι-ορθόω
to set in order further: Tt 1:5 (Inscr.; Cremer, 8O8).†
(AS)

G1931.def:
ἐπι-δύω
[in LXX: Dt 24:15, Js 8:29, Jr 15:9 (בּוֹא)* ;]
to go down, set (of the sun): Ef 4:26.†
(AS)

G1932.def:
ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2:19 12:18 Bar.2:27, from LXX Bar.4:24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2:22 2Mac 10:4, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 7:6 * ;]
fairness, moderation, gentleness ("sweet reasonableness," Matthew Arnold): At 24:4; with πραΰτης, 2Co 10:1.†
SYN.: πραΰτης (see Tr., Syn., § xliii) (AS)

G1933.def:
ἐπιεικής, -ές
(εἰκός, likely), [in LXX: Sl 86:5 (סַלָּח), Et 8:13 * ;]
__1. seemly, fitting (Hom.).
__2. equitable, fair, moderate: 1Tm 3:3, Tt 3:2, 1Pe 2:18, Tg 3:17; τὸ ἐ. (Thuc., i, 76), Fp 4:5 (cf. Mayor, Ja, l.with, and see: ἐπιεικία).†
ἐπιείκεια see: ἐπιεικία
ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2:19 12:18 Bar.2:27, from LXX Bar.4:24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2:22 2Mac 10:4, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 7:6 * ;]
fairness, moderation, gentleness ("sweet reasonableness," Matthew Arnold): At 24:4; with πραΰτης, 2Co 10:1.†
SYN.: πραΰτης (see Tr., Syn., § xliii) (AS)

G1934.def:
ἐπι-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, 4Ki.8:8, Is 62:12, al.; also for בָּקַשׁ, 3Ki.20:1, Ec 7:28), Os 3:5; פָּקַד, 4Ki.3:8 ;]
"directive" of ζητέω (MM, Exp., xiv),
to inquire for, seek after, wish for: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 6:32 12:39 16:4, Lc 12:30, At 19:39, Rm 11:7, Fp 4:17, Hb 11:14 13:14; with accusative of person(s), Lc 4:42, At 12:19; with inf., At 13:7.†
(AS)

G1936.def:
ἐπί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιτίθημι), [in LXX: 2Cr 25:27 (קֶשֶׁר), Ez 23:11 (עֲגָבָה) 2Ma.4:41 2Mac 5:5 2Mac 14:15 * ;]
__1. a laying on: χειρῶν, At 8:18, 1Tm 4:14, 2Tm 1:6, Hb 6:2 (cf. Westc., He., l.with; CGT on 1Ti, l.with).
__2. an attack, assault (2Mac, ll.with).†
(AS)

G1937.def:
ἐπιθυμέω, -ῶ
(θυμός), [in LXX chiefly for אָוָה pi., hithp.; also for חָמַד, etc. ;]
to set one's heart upon, desire, lust after, covet: absol., Tg 4:2, Rm 7:7 13:9" (LXX), 1Co 10:6 (of. 4Ma.2:6); before κατά (against, in opposition to), Gl 5:17; prop. (as in cl.) with genitive, At 20:33, 1Tm 3:1; in late Gk. also with accusative (M, Pr., 65), Mt 5:28 (Rec. αὐτῆς; T omits; cf. Êx 20:17, Mq 2:2, Wis.16:3, al.); with inf., Mt 13:17, Lc 15:16 16:21 17:22, 1Pe 1:12, Ap 9:6; with accusative and inf., Hb 6:11; as in Hebrew, ἐπιθυμία ἐπεθύμησα, Lc 22:15.†
SYN.: ὀρέγω (cf. Field, Notes, 204), θέλω (DCG. i, 453) (AS)

G1938.def:
ἐπιθυμητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπιθυμέω) [in LXX: Nm 11:34 (אָוָה hithp.); εἶναι ἐ., Pv 1:22 (חָמַד)* ;]
one longing for, lustful after: κακῶν, 1Co 10:6.†
(AS)

G1939.def:
ἐπιθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(έπιθυμέω), [in LXX chiefly for תַּאֲוָה, אָוָה; also for חֶמֶד, etc. ;]
desire, longing: Lc 22:15 (see: ἐπιθυμέω), Fp 1:23, 1Ts 2:17, Ap 18:14; p1., Mc 4:19; esp. with ref. to forbidden things, desire, lust (Vg., concupiscentia): Rm 7:7-8, Tg 1:14-15, 2Pe 1:4; pl., Gl 5:24, 1Tm 6:9, 2Tm 2:22 4:3, 1Pe 1:14 4:2; πάθος ἐπιθυμίας, 1Ts 4:5; ἐ. κακή, Cl 3:5; with genitive, μιασμοῦ, 2Pe 2:10 (see Mayor, in l); τ. καρδιῶν, Rm 1:24; τ. κόσμου (aroused by the world), 1Jo 2:17; τ. σώματος, Rm 6:12; τ. ἀπάτης, Ef 4:22 (see ICC, in l); τ. σαρκός, 1Jo 2:16, 2Pe 2:18 (without art.), Gl 5:16; τ. ὀφθαλμῶν, 1Jo 2:16; σαρκικαὶ ἐ., 1Pe 2:11 (cf. 4Ma.1:32); κοσμικαί, Tt 2:12; εἰς ἐπιθυμίας, Rm 13:14; ποιεῖν τὰς ἐ., Jo 8:44; ὑπακούειν ταῖς ἐ., Rm 6:12; δουλεύειν, ἄγεσθαι, ἐπιθυμίαις, Tt 3:3, 2Tm 3:6; πορεύειθαι ἐν ἐ., 1Pe 4:3; κατά, Ju 16 18, 2Pe 3:3; ἀναστρέφεσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐ., Ef 2:3.†
SYN.: πάθος (which see), ὄρεξις (AS)

G1940.def:
ἐπι-καθ-ίζω
[in LXX for רָכַב, etc. ;]
to sit upon: Mt 21:7.†
(AS)

G1941.def:
ἐπι-καλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
__1. to call, name, surname: with accusative (cl.), Mt 10:25; pass., At 1:23 4:36 10:5, 18 10:22 11:13 12:12, 25, Hb 11:16; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐπί (denoting possession, as Heb. עַל. . שֻׁם קָרָא), At 15:17 (LXX), Tg 2:7 (see. CB on Am 9:12).
__2. Mid. (so also act.; cl., LXX), to call upon, invoke, appeal to (θεόν, θεούς, Hdt., Xen., al.; cf. Deiss., LAE, 426): Καίσαρα (Σεβαστόν, At 25:25), At 25:11-12, 21 26:32 28:19; sc. τ. Κύριον Ἰησοῦν, At 7:59; μάρτυρα (cl.) τ. θεόν, 2Co 1:23; πατέρα, 1Pe 1:17; τ. κύριον, Rm 10:12, 2Tm 2:22; τ. ὄνομα κυρίου (μου, σου; like Heb. יְהוָֹה שֻׁם קָרָא), At 2:21 (LXX) At 9:14, 21 22:16, Rm 10:13-14" (LXX) 1Co 1:2 (Cremer, 335, 742).†
(AS)

G1942.def:
ἐπι-κάλυμμα, -τος, τό
(ἐπικαλύπτω), [in LXX: Êx 26:14 39:34, (מְכַסֶּה), 4Ki.17:19 (מָסָךְ), Jó 19:29 (aliter in Heb.)* ;]
a cover, veil: metaphorically, τ. κακίας, 1Pe 2:16.†
(AS)

G1943.def:
ἐπι-καλύπτω
[in LXX for כָּסָה, etc. ;]
to cover over, cover up: metaphorically, Rm 4:7 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1944.def:
ἐπι-κατ-άρατος, -ον
(ἐπικαταράομαι, to imprecate curses on), [in LXX for אָרַר, also Wis.3:12 14:8, 4Ma.2:19 ;]
accursed: Gl 3:10 (LXX) Gl 3:13 (LXX κεκαταραμένος) (Cremer, 109).†
(AS)

G1945.def:
ἐπι-κείμαι
[in LXX: Êx 39:31 (נָתַן), Jó 19:3 (הָכַר hi.) Jó 21:27 (חָמַס), 1Ma.6:57, 2Ma.1:21, 3Ma.1:22 * ;]
to be placed, lie on: Jo 21:9; before ἐπί, with dative, Jo 11:38; figuratively, Hb 9:10; ἀνάγκη, 1Co 9:16; χειμῶν, to threaten, come on: At 27:20; of persons, to press upon: Lc 5:1 23:23.†
(AS)

G1946.def:
Ἐπικούριος (Rec. -ειος), -ου, ὁ
an Epicurean, a follower of Epicurus: At 17:18.†
(AS)

G1947.def:
ἐπικουρία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπικουρέω to be an ἐπίκουρος, an ally) [in LXX: Wis.13:18 * ;]
aid, assistance: At 26:22.†
(AS)

G1948.def:
ἐπι-κρίνω
[in LXX: 2Ma.4:47, 3Ma.4:2 * ;]
to decree, give sentence: with accusative and inf., Lc 23:24.†
(AS)

G1949.def:
ἐπι-λαμβάνω
[in LXX for חָזַק hi., אָחַז, etc. ;]
always mid. in LXX and NT (see Cremer, 758), to lap hold of: with genitive of person(s), Mt 14:31, At 17:19 21:30, 33; with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Lc 9:47 14:4 23:26 (WH, but see Bl., 1015), At 9:27 16:9 18:17; with genitive of thing(s), Mc 8:23, At 23:10, Hb 8:9" (LXX) ; with genitive of person(s) and of thing(s), Lc 20:20, 26; τ. αἰωνίου (ὄντως) ζωῆς, 1Tm 6:12 6:19. Metaphorical (as in Sir.4:11), Hb 2:16 (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G1950.def:
ἐπι-λανθάνομαι
(alternative mid, form of ἐπιλήθω, to cause to forget) [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַח ;]
to forget, neglect: with inf., Mt 16:5, Mc 8:14; with genitive, Hb 6:10 13:2, 16; with accusative (as occasionally in cl.; MM, Exp., xiv), Fp 3:13; ὁποῖος ἦν, Tg 1:24; pass. ptcp. (cf. Is 23:16, Sir.3:14 23:14, Wis.2:4), Lc 12:6.†
(AS)

G1951.def:
ἐπι-λέγω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;]
__1. to say in addition (Hdt.).
__2. to call by name, to call: Jo 5:2.
__3. to choose; mid., to choose for oneself: At 15:40.†
(AS)

G1952.def:
ἐπι-λείπω
[in LXX: Ob 5 א1 R (שָׁאַר hi.) * ;]
to fail: with accusative of person(s), Hb 11:32.†
(AS)

G1953.def:
ἐπι-λησμονή, -ις, ή
(επιλήθω), [in LXX: Sir.11:27 * ;]
forgetful­ness: ἀκροατὴς ἐ. (genitive of qual.), Tg 1:25.†
(AS)

G1954.def:
ἐπί-λοιπος, -ον
(λοιπός), [in LXX for יָתַר, שָׁאַר ;]
still left, remaining: χρόνος, 1Pe 4:2.†
(AS)

G1955.def:
ἐπί-λυσις -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιλύω), [in Aq.: Gn 40:8; Sm.: Os 3:4 * ;]
__1. release.
__2. solution, interpretation: 2Pe 1:20.†
(AS)

G1956.def:
ἐπι-λύω
[in Aq.: Gn 40:8 41:8, 12; Th.: Os 3:4 * ;]
__1. to loose, release.
__2. to solve, settle, explain: Mc 4:34, At 19:39.†
(AS)

G1957.def:
ἐπι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
to bear witness to: with accusative and inf., 1Pe 5:12,†
(AS)

G1958.def:
ἐπιμέλεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιμελέομαι), [in LXX: Pv 3:8 (שִׁקּוּי), Wis.13:13, Et 6:10, 1Ma.16:14, al. ;]
attention, care: At 27:3 (see Field, Notes, 143).†
(AS)

G1959.def:
ἐπι-μελεομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: Gn 44:21 (עַיִן שׂוּם) I Et 6:27, Pv 27:25, Sir.30:25, 1Ma.11:37 * ;]
to take care of: with genitive, Lc 10:34-35, 1Tm 3:5.†
(AS)

G1961.def:
ἐπι-μένω
[in LXX: Êx 12:39 (מָהַהּ hith.)* ;]
to stay on, tarry or abide still: before έν, 1Co 16:8; αὐτοῦ, there, At 15:34 (WH, txt., RV, txt., omit) At 21:4; with dative, τ. σαρκί, Fp 1:24; before παρά, with dative of person(s), At 28:14; πρός, with accusative of person(s), 1Co 16:7, Gl 1:18; with accusative temp., At 10:48 21:4, 10 28:12, 14, 1Co 16:7. Metaphorical, to continue in a pursuit or state: with dative, τ. ἀμαρτίᾳ, Rm 6:1; τ. ὰπιστίᾳ, Rm 11:23; τ. πίστει, Cl 1:23; αὐτοῖς (see CGT, in l), 1Tm 4:16; τ. χρηστότητι, Rm 11:22; with ptcp. (cf. Bl., § 73, 4; 76, 2), Jo 8:7, At 12:16.†
(AS)

G1962.def:
ἐπι-νεύω
[in LXX: Pv 26:24 (נָכַר ni.), 1Ma.6:57, 2Ma.4:10 2Mac 11:15 2Mac 14:20 * ;]
to nod in command or approval, to nod approval, consent: At 18:20.†
(AS)

G1963.def:
ἐπίνοια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπινοέω, to contrive) [in LXX: Jr 20:10, Wis.6:16 9:14 14:12 15:4, Sir.40:2, 2Ma.12:45, 4Ma.17:2 * ;]
a thought, design: At 8:22.†
(AS)

G1964.def:
ἐπιορκέω, -ῶ
(ἐπίορκος), [in LXX: I Et 1:48, Wis.14:28 * ;]
to swear falsely, forswear oneself: Mt 5:33.†
(AS)

G1965.def:
ἐπί-ορκος, -ον
[in LXX: Zc 5:3 (שָׁבַע ni.) * ;]
__1. of oaths, sworn falsely.
__2. Of persons, perjured; as subst., a perjurer, false swearer: 1Tm 1:10.†
(AS)

G1966.def:
ἔπ-ειμι
[in LXX: Êx 8:22 (עָמַד), Sir.42:19, etc. ;]
__1. to come upon, approach
__2. Of time, to come on or after; mostly as ptcp., ἐπιών, -οῦσα, όν, next, following: τῇ- ἔ. (sc.ἡμέρᾳ, as frequently in late Gk.), At 16:11 20:15 21:18; ἡμέρᾳ (as usual in cl.), At 7:26; νυκτί, At 23:11.†
(AS)

G1967.def:
ἐπιούσιος, -ον
(cf. περιούσιος, [in LXX for סְגֻלָּה, etc.]),
found only in the phrase ἄρτος ἐ., EV, daily; R, mg., for the coming day: Mt 6:11, Lc 11:3. (Several derivations find support, each pointing to a different meaning.
__1. ἐπιοῦσα (sc. ἡμέρα) (or, ἐπὶ τὴν ἰοῦσαν (sc. ήμέραν), Zorell, see word), hence, for the morrow or for the coming day (R, mg.).
__2. (a) ἐπί + οὐσία, hence, for subsistence, needful (Am. R, mg.);
__(b) ἐπί + εἶναι in fern. ptcp. form, hence, pertaining to (the day). For renderings of versions and views of various writers, see reff. in DB, ext., 36 f.; DCG, ii, 58 f., 62a; ICC on Lk, l.with The EV, daily, is based on the Vg. (Lk; OL, Mt, Lk, quotidianus). "It is difficult not to think that τὸν ἐ. rests upon misunderstanding of an original Aramaic phrase, or upon a Greek corruption" (ICC on Mt, l.with; cf. also Cremer, 239).†
(AS)

G1968.def:
ἐπι-πίπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
to fall upon (Field, Notes, 25): with dative of person(s), Mc 3:10 (see Swete, in l), At 20:10; before ἐπὶ τ. τράχηλον (as Gn 46:29, Tob.11:8, 3Ma.5:49, al.), Lc 15:20, At 20:37. Metaphorical, φόβος, Lc 1:12, At 19:17, Ap 11:11; ὀνειδισμοί, Rm 15:3 (LXX); of the Holy Spirit: before ἐπί, with dative, At 8:16; ἐπί, with accusative, At 10:44 11:15; absol., At 23:7.†
(AS)

G1969.def:
ἐπι-πλήσσω
__1. to strike at, to punish.
__2. to rebuke, reprove: 1Tm 5:1.†
(AS)

G1971.def:
ἐπι-ποθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for יָאַב, אָרַג, כָּסַף hi., etc. ;]
to long for, desire: with inf., Rm 1:11, 2Co 5:2, 1Ts 3:6, 2Tm 1:4, Fp 2:26 (WH, [txt.]); with accusative of thing(s), 1Pe 2:2; with accusative of person(s), 2Co 9:14, Fp 1:8 2:26 (WH, mg); absol., Tg 4:5 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G1975.def:
ἐπι-πορεύομαι
[in LXX: Lv 26:33 (אָחַר), Eze.39:14 (עָבַר), Ep. Jr 6:2, 2Ma.2:28, 3Ma.1:4 * ;]
to travel, journey to: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Lc 8:4.†
(AS)

G1976.def:
ἐπι-ράπτω (Rec. -ρράπτω),
to sew upon: before ἐπί, with accusative, Mc 2:21.†
(AS)

G1977.def:
ἐπι-ρίπτω
(Rec. -ρρίπτω, as in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַךְ hi. ;]
__1. to cast at.
__2. to cast or place upon: with accusative before ἐπί, with accusative, Lc 19:35; metaphorically, τ. μέριμναν, 1Pe 5:7 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1978.def:
ἐπίσημος, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: Gn 30:42 (קָשַׁר), Et 5:4 8:13, 1Ma.11:37 1Mac 14:48, 2Ma.15:36, 3Ma.6:1 * ;]
__1. bearing a mark; of money, stamped, coined.
__2. Metaphorical,
__(a) in good sense, notable, illustrious: Rm 16:7;
__(b) in bad sense, notorious: Mt 27:16.†
(AS)

G1979.def:
ἐπισιτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπισιτίζομαι, to supply with provisions), [in LXX: Gn 42:25, al. (צֵידָה), Jdth.2:18 4:5 ;]
__1. a foraging.
__2. provisions, food: Lc 9:12.†
(AS)

G1980.def:
ἐπι-σκέπτομαι
(late form of ἐπισκοπέω, which see), [in LXX very freq., chiefly for פָּקַד ;]
__1. to inspect, examine.
__2. (a) to visit: with accusative, At 7:23 15:36 (cf. Jz 15:1); especially, the sick and afflicted (as in MGr. and sometimes in cl.), Mt 25:36, 43, Tg 1:27 (cf. Sir.7:35);
__(b) in LXX and NT (as פָּקַד in Gn 21:1, Êx 4:31, Sl 8:5, al.), to visit with help, to care for: Lc 1:68, 78 7:16, At 15:14, Hb 2:6;
__(with) to visit with punishment (Jr 9:25, Sl 89:33, al.; cf. MM, Exp., xiv; Cremer, 863).†
(AS)

G1981.def:
ἐπι-σκηνόω, -ῶ
to tent upon, spread a tabernacle over: metaphorically, before ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ (RV, rest upon, cover), 2Co 12:9.†
(AS)

G1982.def:
ἐπι-σκιάζω
[in LXX: Êx 40:35 (שָׁכַן), Sl 91:4 140:7 (סָכַךְ), Pv 18:11 * ;]
to throw a shadow upon, overshadow: with dative, At 5:15; of a shining (Mt, l.with, and cf. Êx 40:29, 35, 2Ma.2:8) cloud, with dative, Mc 9:7; with accusative, Mt 17:5, Lc 9:34; metaphorically (cf. Pss, Pr, ll.with), of the Holy Spirit, Lc 1:35.†
(AS)

G1983.def:
ἐπι-σκοπέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for פָּקַד ni., etc. ;]
__1. to look upon, observe, examine: before μή, Hb 12:16.
__2. As ἐπισκέπτομαι in LXX, NT, to visit, care for: 1Pe 5:2 (R, txt.; WH cm.; Cremer, 527).†
(AS)

G1984.def:
ἐπι-σκοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiey for פָּקַד פְּקֻדָּה ;]
__1. a visiting, visitation (εἰς ἐ. τοῦ παιδός, Lucian, dial. deor., 20, 6); as in LXX (after Heb.), of God's visitation in mercy, or in judgment (Lv 19:20 Jó 10:12, Jr 6:15, Wis.2:20, al.): Lc 19:44, 1Pe 2:12 (see Hort, in l).
__2. office, charge, esp. office of an ἐπίσκοιος (which see): At 1:20 (LXX), 1Tm 3:1 (Cremer, 527 f., 864; DCG, ii, 809b).†
(AS)

G1985.def:
ἐπί-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ
(σκοπός, a watcher), [in LXX for פָּקַד, its parts and derivatives, Nm 4:16 31:14, Jz 9:28, 4Ki.11:15 11:18, 2Cr 34:12 34:17, Ne 11:9, 14 11:22; אֵל, Jó 20:29; נָגַשׂ:, Is 60:17; Wis.1:6, 1Ma.1:51 * ;]
a superintendent, guardian, overseer (cl.; for exx. see LS, see word): At 20:28, 1Pe 2:25 (ICC, in l); as technical term for a religious office (Deiss., BS, 230 f.), in later Paul. epp. of the head of a church (Vg. episcopus), a bishop: Fp 1:1, 1Tm 3:2, Tt 1:7 (see reff. see word ἐπισκοπή).†
(AS)

G1986.def:
ἐπι-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Is 5:18 (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;]
to draw on: mid., in peculiar sense of effacing signs of Judaism (cf. 1Ma.1:15, FlJ, Ant., xii, 5, i; see Thayer, see word), to become as uncircumcised: 1Co 7:18.†
(AS)

G1987.def:
ἐπίσταμαι
(prob. an old mid, of ἐφίστημι, which see), [in LXX chiefly for יָדַע ;]
to know, know of, understand: with accusative of person(s), At 19:15; with ptcp., At 24:10; with accusative of thing(s), Mc 14:68, At 18:25, 1Tm 6:4, Tg 4:14, Ju 10; before περί, At 26:26; ὅτι, At 15:7 19:25 22:19; ὡς, At 10:28; πῶς, At 20:18; ποῦ, Hb 11:8.†
SYN: γινώσκω (which see), οἶδα
(AS)

G1988.def:
ἐπιστάτης, -ου, ό
(ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: 4Ki.25:19, Jr 29:26 52:25 (פָּקִיד), 2Cr 31:12 (נָגִיד), 2Ma.5:22, etc. ;]
a chief, commander, master: Lc 5:5 8:24, 45 9:33, 49 17:13 (cf. Dalman, Words, 336 ff.).†
(AS)

G1989.def:
ἐπι-στέλλω
[in LXX: 3Ki.5:8 Ne 6:19 (שָׁלַח), Jdth.15:4, 1Ma.10:25 1Mac 12:7 1Mac 13:18 (in each case with seel. ἀποσ-) * ;]
__1. to send to.
__2. to send a message by letter, to write word (MM, Exp., xiv): with dative of person(s), At 21:25, Hb 13:22; before τοῦ, with inf., At 15:20.†
(AS)

G1990.def:
ἐπιστήμων, -ον, genitive, -ονoς
(ἐπίσταμαι) [in LXX: Dt 1:13 4:6, Is 5:21 (בִּין ni.), I Et 8:44, Sir.10:25 21:15, etc. ;]
knowing, skilled: Tg 3:13.†
(AS)

G1991.def:
ἐπι-στηρίζω
[in LXX for סָמַךְ, etc. ;]
to make stronger, confirm: with accusative, At 14:22 15:32, 41.†
(AS)

G1992.def:
ἐπι-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιατέλλω), [in LXX for אִגֶּרֶת, etc.; frequently in Mac ;]
__1. a message.
__2. a letter, an epistle: At 9:2, 1Co 5:9, al.; pl., At 22:5, 1Co 16:3, al.; ἐ. σνστατικαί, 2Co 3:1 (cf. Milligan, NTD, 254 f.). (On the NT ἐπιστολαί, cf. Milligan, Th., 121 ff.; NTD, 85 ff.; Deiss., BS, 3 ff.; St. Paul, 8 ff.)
(AS)

G1993.def:
ἐπι-στομίζω
(στόμα),
to bridle; metaphorically, to stop the mouth, to silence: Tt 1:11.†
(AS)

G1994.def:
ἐπι-στρέφω
[very frequently in LXX, chiefly for שׁוּב, in its various senses, also for פָּנָה, etc. ;]
__1. trans., to turn about, round or towards, hence metaphorically, to turn, cause to return (to God, virtue, etc.): Lc 1:16-17 (cf. Ml 3:24), Tg 5:19-20.
__2. Intrans.,
__(a) to turn, turn oneself around: At 16:18; with inf., Ap 1:12; before πρός, At 9:40; so also pass. (cl.), Mc 5:30 8:33, Jo 21:20; metaphorically, of turning to God (see Field, Notes, 246 ff.), ἐπὶ τ. κύριον (θεόν), At 9:35 11:21 14:15 15:19 26:20; πρὸς τ. θεόν, 1Ts 1:9, 2Co 3:16; ἀπὸ σκότους εἰς φῶς, At 26:18; pass., 1Pe 2:25;
__(b) to return (as in MGr.): Lc 8:55, At 15:36; before ὀπίσω, with inf., Mt 24:18; before εἰς, Mt 12:44, Mc 13:16, Lc 2:39 17:31; ἐπί, 2Pe 2:22; metaphorically, before ἐπί, Gl 4:9; πρός, Lc 17:4; of moral reform, Mt 13:15, Mc 4:12, Lc 22:32, At 3:19 28:27; pass., Mt 10:13 (Cremer, 531, 881).†
(AS)

G1995.def:
ἐπι-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιστρέφω) [in LXX: Eze.47:7 (שׁוּב), Sir.18:21 49:2, etc. ;]
a turning about; metaphorically, conversion (Field, Notes, 246): At 15:3.†
(AS)

G1996.def:
ἐπι-συν-άγω
[in LXX for אָסַף, קָבַץ, etc. (Cremer, 65) ;]
__1. to gather together: Mt 23:37 24:31, Mc 13:27, Lc 13:34; pass., Mc 1:33, Lc 12:1 17:37, (cf. Sl 102:23 106:47, 2Ma.1:27, al.).
__2. to gather together against (Mq 4:11, Zc 12:3, 1Ma.3:58, al.).†
(AS)

G1997.def:
ἐπι-συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπισυνάγω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:7 * ;]
a gathering together, assembly: Hb 10:25; before ἐπί, 2Ts 2:1 (cf. 2Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G1998.def:
ἐπι-συν-τρέχω
to run together again: Mc 9:25 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)
